rule: Count only evidence that exercises current production physics/runtime for production-proven claims. Harness-only and pre-solver fail-closed tests remain separate classes.

claims.claim: an accepted production interval commits exactly once
evidence: both routes execute the serialized Reference backend with real HeadCalc
claims.limits: Restricted prescribed-qbot Reference production route; not a universal proof for every optional-process composition.

claims.claim: hard mass accounting is closed on accepted production intervals
evidence: positive bottom inflow has explicit positive total_in and total_out
FVQ75 independently replays the production route and checks transfer closure
claims.limits: This proves accepted-route conservation in the restricted route, not rejected-trial flux exclusion by itself.

claims.claim: non-day and non-calendar-aligned physical intervals execute through production physics
evidence: the positive-qbot route executes one principal HeadCalc trajectory and commits
claims.limits: The fixture starts at numeric t0=0; it proves generic duration semantics, not every calendar adapter interpretation.

claims.claim: unsupported requests fail before physical execution and leave revision unchanged
evidence: nearby unowned bottom mode has committed=false
claims.limits: This is pre-solver rejection. It is not evidence that a physically executed but later rejected trial rolls back correctly.

claims.claim: a physically executed but rejected production trial leaves committed physical state unchanged
partial_evidence: F-KT22 executes the serialized Reference backend and proves rejected full-trial tangent work is absent from accepted trajectory publication
F-CI52 qualification reports rollback and single-commit semantics for the restricted fixed-weir runtime
claims.why_not_closed: The publication programme still lacks one pinned focused production experiment that snapshots committed water state before and after a post-solver rejected trial and checks exact unchanged state/revision on the selected Paper 1 route.

claims.claim: rejected-trial water transfers never enter committed water totals
partial_evidence: transaction code publishes accepted-route accounting only
F-KT22 proves rejected full-trial derivative work is excluded from accepted publication
claims.why_not_closed: A code-path argument plus rejected diagnostic-work test is weaker than a direct production mass-ledger fault-injection test. Paper 1 should add the latter.

claims.claim: rerunning the same committed physical state is deterministic within the declared build envelope
evidence: FMR44R output is identical between O0 and O2
FVQ75 independently replays the same production capability
claims.why_not_closed: Optimization-invariant independent runs are strong reproducibility evidence but are not an explicit same-process checkpoint -> run -> restore -> rerun identity experiment.

claims.claim: numerical warm-start variation does not change accepted physical output beyond a declared tolerance
claims.historical_evidence: TX-WARM-01 exists in the old synthetic VQ suite
claims.why_not_closed: Historical VQ evidence explicitly did not execute production physics. No current production warm-start perturbation qualification has been pinned for Paper 1.

publication_conclusion: Current SWAP5 already provides strong restricted-route production evidence for single-commit semantics, hard mass closure and generic-duration execution. The minimum new Paper 1 transaction experiment should target post-solver rollback plus rejected-transfer exclusion; warm-start invariance remains a separate missing experiment.
